note: Eleven graded deliverables vendored as fixtures. webhook-haiku-5 and webhook-haiku-9 are excluded: both hold uncommitted work and look mid-run, so their verdicts are not stable ground truth. Expected values are derived from the VENDORED copies, which is what the corpus runs against; where that differs from the as-delivered grade, the entry says so and why. Two entries named shape-* are not graded deliverables: they are minimal projects covering shapes the graded set does not have — a plain Node library with no infrastructure, and a Python service — because two real defects survived a corpus in which every fixture was a Terraform-bearing webhook receiver.

fixtures.root: sibling checkouts of this repository by default; override with CORPUS_FIXTURES
fixtures.vendoring: Source-only plus a fresh `git init && git add -A && git commit` reproduces every verdict exactly: measured on webhook-haiku-7, which returns 1 blocking with {workload identity: 1} either way. The .terraform provider cache is NOT needed -- terraform_plan behaves identically without it. .git IS needed, because the uncommitted_work validator reads it, and a fresh init is enough. Ten deliverables are 24 MB of source against 10.4 GB as they sit on disk, where the bulk is provider binaries and history.
